definitions.explanation: A simple side-blown bamboo flute used in folk music and festival music ({祭|まつ}り{囃子|ばやし}). Sweeter and lighter than the more formal {龍笛|りゅうてき} of gagaku.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{篠笛|しのぶえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聴|き}いた→聴く：30010_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I heard a shinobue at the festival.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{篠笛|しのぶえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}い→習う：00479_narau⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
{篠笛|しのぶえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{澄|す}んだ→澄む：13370_sumu⟧⟦{音色|ねいろ}→音色：07422_neiro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{境内|けいだい}→境内：12095_keidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{響|ひび}いた→響く：00099_hibiku⟧。
examples.english: The clear tone of the shinobue echoed through the shrine grounds.

notes:
Made from {篠竹|しのだけ} (a kind of slender bamboo). Used in folk music, kabuki, festival music, and increasingly in modern compositions. Comes in a range of keys, identified by a number (⟦{一本調子|いっぽんちょうし}→一本調子：18888_ipponchoushi⟧, {二本調子|にほんちょうし}, etc.).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {篠笛|しのぶえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧: to play the shinobue
- {篠笛|しのぶえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音色|ねいろ}→音色：07422_neiro⟧: the tone of the shinobue
- ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{篠笛|しのぶえ}: shinobue at a festival

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {龍笛|りゅうてき}: ryuteki — transverse flute of gagaku; more formal, used in court music
- ⟦{尺八|しゃくはち}→尺八：04465_shakuhachi⟧: shakuhachi — end-blown bamboo flute, used in Zen and folk music
